_note: Thin routing registry. Holds POINTERS + probe specs + policy text only. It never copies current truth (state is fetched live by probes at build time). Add a new domain by adding a key under 'domains'; do not widen an existing domain to own things it does not.

not_authority: WPC / deck product state - business.floow does NOT own WPC/deck. A real wpc.* or deck.* domain owns those; keep them separate.
today-briefing is a derived view, not floow intent authority

defaults_and_guards: Floow.md is manually maintained - cross-check against the live backlog before treating any line as current execution state.
do_not: Do NOT surface WPC/deck as floow's 'current' work - they belong to a separate domain.
Do NOT treat an aging manual Floow.md as live execution status.
business.floow.recommended_use: Scope reasoning to floow product intent only; confirm the current phase against the live backlog, not this doc's age.

state_probes.name: company_goals_ambiguity
state_probes.command: GET http://127.0.0.1:3101/api/companies/<id>/goals (read-only) - inspect active root goals and createdAt to detect ambiguous default
state_probes.why: Detect >1 active root goal or non-active default before any routing decision. NOT executed in read-only Phase 0.

not_authority: hermes-paperclip-operating-protocol.md (v0.1, stale) is a procedure draft, not current routing truth

allowed_when: auditing how a past issue was routed

defaults_and_guards: Server default company goal = oldest active root goal by createdAt (services/goals.ts). If there is >1 active root goal, or the default's status != active, the default is AMBIGUOUS.
Goal fallback code change is Phase 2 - this packet only SURFACES the policy, it does not enforce it.
do_not: Do NOT attach a default deck/WPC goal to an ambiguous issue.
When projectId/goalId/parentId are all absent, require an explicit goalId or leave goalId=null (needs-triage) - never inherit the stale company default.
paperclip.issue.recommended_use: For an ambiguous issue, require an explicit goalId or mark needs-triage; never silently inherit the default company goal.

intent_authority.owns: today's stated intent (often a missing/empty template)

state_probes.name: pim_today_tasks
state_probes.command: sqlite3 'file:{home}/.local/share/pim/secretary.db?mode=ro' "SELECT title,due FROM tasks WHERE date(due)=date('now','localtime')"
state_probes.why: Live PIM evidence for today. Read-only; not executed in Phase 0.

state_probes.name: calendar_today
state_probes.why: Live calendar evidence for today. Not executed in Phase 0.

not_authority: An empty or missing _DailyNotes template is NOT today's intent

allowed_when: reviewing prior days' focus on request

defaults_and_guards: Today's _DailyNotes file is frequently missing or an empty template - it must not be read as confirmed intent.
do_not: Do NOT infer today's focus from an empty or missing daily note.
Require PIM tasks + calendar + live briefing evidence; if those are unavailable, say focus is unconfirmed rather than guessing.
daily-focus.recommended_use: Derive today's focus only from confirmed PIM/calendar/live-briefing evidence; explicitly flag when that evidence is missing.

intent_authority.owns: linux ops guide (may lag live state)

not_authority: linux-operations-guide.md wiki text may be stale (e.g. Syncthing restart) - live probe wins over the doc

defaults_and_guards: Live infra state = systemctl is-active + ops-watch probe, NOT the wiki/operating-model prose.
do_not: Do NOT trust wiki/operating-model text over live systemctl/ops-watch state (e.g. Syncthing on/off).
Do NOT restart services or mutate state - this domain is read-only diagnosis.
infra.hermes.recommended_use: Confirm infra state from live probes (systemctl/ops-watch); treat docs as intent only and prefer the probe when they disagree.
